verdict_reason: A local npm test log committed by mistake; it should not be in the PR

todos.issue: Commit 49021f3 ('drop the branch address records from the address book stub') commits five local npm test logs (workareas/rebase-fix/npm-test.log, npm-test2.log to npm-test5.log, about 280 KB) to the animals frontend. They are a developer's scratch output, not source: they carry the developer's local home path (npm-test.log:22) and stale failures (npm-test.log:178 'Cannot find module ../commodities/line-title.js'). The repo's .gitignore does not ignore workareas/.
todos.fix: Must: the PR adds no workareas/ files. One way: git rm -r workareas/rebase-fix in this PR, and add workareas/ to .gitignore.
